title: Actor
description: IT domain composite for Actor, materializing its applicable cross-framework facets. Typing: extends Actor (chain converges to its GSM base). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties. Mount-key distinctness within one composite is the author's responsibility now that titles are no longer framework-prefixed). Mounted facets — attributed-to: Attribution; responsibility-of: Association, Delegation. Source: hand-authored, TOGAF business-architecture stratum.

association.description: Optional Association facet mount (ontology axis: responsibility-of). Facet-internal required members apply only when this mount is present.

attribution.description: Optional Attribution facet mount (ontology axis: attributed-to). Facet-internal required members apply only when this mount is present.

delegation.description: Optional Delegation facet mount (ontology axis: responsibility-of). Facet-internal required members apply only when this mount is present.
